notablePrerequisites:
Dune-Brood Nephilim does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block Dune-Brood Nephilim.
You control at least six lands.
description:
Deal combat damage with Dune-Brood Nephilim.
Dune-Brood Nephilim triggers, creating a 1/1 Sand creature token for each land you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing five Sand tokens, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and getting an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat.
